com.ecom.admin.release_notes: Simpler field missions with one clear next action, compact shop and equipment context, six live progress stages, and easier access to history, evidence and handoff. Improved Korean and English guidance.

com.ecom.order.release_notes: Clearer phone and tablet layouts, reliable retry after failed reads, preserved order dates, complete customer names and financial amounts, and corrected invoice balance reporting.

com.ecom.hrm.release_notes: Keep settings tied to the selected shop, verify saved values, and improve configuration error handling.

com.ecom.supply.release_notes: Clearer phone and tablet layouts, reliable retry after failed reads, preserved order dates, complete customer names and financial amounts, and corrected invoice balance reporting.

com.ecom.beauty.release_notes: Show Location automatically from the registered shop address with directions from your current location. Remove map content editing and require verified owner or manager consent before ECOM homepage edits.

com.ecom.kiosk.release_notes: Observe the active internet path from authenticated shop-bound stations without interrupting attendance. Support wired and LTE reference matching in Admin.

testflight.notes: Simpler navigation with Field, Overview, Reports and Manage. Find tools with management search, return to the same shop with Back, and keep report drafts while switching sections. Secondary history, monitoring and report tools are available on demand. Improved phone and tablet layouts in English and Korean.
